title: The Red SMP
description: Economy-based with Crystal PvP specialization, this server offers a balanced progression where trading, farming, and strategic resource management are key to success.
body:
# 🔴 Welcome to **RED SMP** 🔥

RED SMP is a **Mini-Donut SMP** built for players who enjoy a competitive survival experience with a strong focus on **economy**, **Crystal PvP**, and **base raiding**. Whether you're a solo grinder, a skilled PvPer, or part of a powerful team, every choice you make shapes your journey.

💰 **Player-Driven Economy**
Earn money by farming, mining, trading, and building successful shops. Buy and sell valuable resources, invest wisely, and become one of the richest players on the server.

⚔️ **Crystal PvP**
Fight using optimized Crystal PvP mechanics with balanced gameplay, smooth performance, and a competitive environment where skill always comes first.

💥 **Base Raiding**
Gather resources, build secure bases, form alliances, and raid your enemies to steal their loot. Defend what you've earned and prove your dominance in an ever-changing world.

🛠️ **Custom Features & Exclusive Plugins**
RED SMP includes a wide range of **custom-made plugins** developed exclusively for the server. Enjoy unique gameplay mechanics, exclusive commands, quality-of-life improvements, custom events, and original systems that you won't find anywhere else.

✨ **Server Features**

* Balanced survival gameplay
* Active player economy
* Custom-made plugins
* Unique progression systems
* Optimized Crystal PvP
* Base raiding
* Player shops & trading
* Regular updates
* Competitive leaderboard
* Dedicated staff team
* Lag-free experience

Join RED SMP today, build your legacy, conquer your enemies, and become the most powerful player on the server. The adventure starts now! 🔥
